logic.note: Conducts A → C above its knee, blocks the other way.

timing.note: Instant with each re-solve; the 4 ns reverse recovery is not modelled.

analog.note: Piecewise linear: 0.6 V knee + 4 Ω, about 0.64 V at 10 mA and 1.0 V at 100 mA (datasheet ~0.72 V / 1.0 V). No exponential curve, no temperature drift.

power.note: Warns above 300 mA and 100 V reverse; the part does not fail.

doesNotEmulate: Inductive kick (the simulator has no inductance), so a flyback diode does nothing visible here
testOnRealDevice: A flyback diode across a coil: stripe towards +
